inventory.answer: member of the municipal council of Givry

decision.explanation: The question asks what position Florence Bagnard currently or formerly holds. Document D1 confirms she is currently the Prefect of Lozère (D1S1, D1S2, D1S9). Document D2 confirms she is currently a conseiller municipal de Givry (D2S2, D2S10, D2S13). These are two distinct positions held by the same person, and both are valid under the 'currently or formerly' scope. The term 'member of the municipal council of Givry' is a paraphrase of 'conseiller municipal de Givry' and is not independently sourced, so it is not added as a separate entry.
